KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Opal:
Within me dance all the colours in creation, 
Encased within a shell of gleaming white.
KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Jade:
In eastern lands is my green skin a prize, 
Though in other colours I am found in the deep.
KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Sapphire:
In terrible poetry does my power lie, 
Where young loves failure causes men to weep.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Generic: A statue of Saradomin, there is a plaque with an engraving and an indentation that seems like something small would fit it.
KeysToEntries.Playerchoice.PlaceOpal: Place the opal in the indentation.
KeysToEntries.Playerchoice.PlaceJade: Place the jade in the indentation.
KeysToEntries.PlayerChoice.PlaceSapphire: Place the sapphire in the indentation.
KeysToEntries.CorrectGem: The gem fits perfectly. The plaque opens up, revealing an emblem.
KeysToEntries.Statue.MainText:
Blinded Saradomin still watches true, 
Three sentinels of stone each guard a key.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Main.Link: A statue of Saradomin, there is a plaque at the base with an engraving.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Main.Complete: You place all the emblems into the statue and turn them. In response the statue radiates an aura of calm tranquility and the plaque slides aside to reveal a hidden compartment. You reach in and take your reward.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Main.Complete.NoSpace: You place all the emblems into the statue and turn them. In response the statue radiates an aura of calm tranquility and the plaque slides aside to reveal a hidden compartment. You would reach in and claim your reward, but you're carrying too much stuff right now.
KeysToEntries.Statue.Name: Saradomin Statue

KeysToEntries.Emblem.Desc: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.
KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Jade.1:
In ancient rituals I am considered wise, 
Though rigid as iron does my wisdom keep.
KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Opal.1:
To magpies, my flaws are a source of veneration, 
When my glittering skin is held up to the light.
KeysToEntries.Puzzle.Sapphire.1:
I glitter in the hue of the calmest sky, 
And the shimmering colours of the coldest deep.
KeysToEntries.Statue.MainText.1:
Give each a gemstone eye of glistening hue,
And the lord of order will once more see.
KeysToEntries.CanPlace.Opal: The opal would fit in the indentation.
KeysToEntries.CanPlace.Jade: The jade would fit in the indentation.
KeysToEntries.CanPlace.Sapphire: The sapphire would fit in the indentation.
